Photosynthesis is a process that relies on capturing light from the sun (sunlight) to drive the synthesis of food. Sunlight travels as electromagnetic waves, which is classified as radiant energy. Other forms of energy, such as chemical energy, represent the stored product of this process rather than the environmental input.
